specs.value: 30 amp circuit breaker on the firewall

clock, lighter, courtesy lamps, dome and luggage lamps
A/C high blower speed in-line fuse, Comforton and Four Season
fusible link, molded splice at solenoid "Bat" terminal (Corvette only)
fusible link, molded splice at the horn relay

notes: Fuses are in the fuse panel under the instrument panel. The A/C high blower fuse sits in the wire from the horn relay to the A/C relay.
A circuit breaker opens and closes rapidly under overload, protecting the circuit until the fault is fixed.
The battery positive cable pigtail fusible link (14 gauge brown) is listed as except Corvette.
